attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Text displayed while the editor is empty.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Prevents the user from editing the prose.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of an external document loaded into the editor.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial HTML content of the editor.

methods.name: addTableColumnAfter(): boolean
methods.description: Adds a column after the selected table column; returns true when the command applies, or false when unavailable for the current editor state.

methods.name: addTableRowAfter(): boolean
methods.description: Adds a row after the selected table row; returns true when the command applies, or false when unavailable for the current editor state.

methods.name: deleteTable(): boolean
methods.description: Deletes the table containing the current selection; returns true when the command applies, or false when unavailable for the current editor state.

methods.name: deleteTableColumn(): boolean
methods.description: Deletes the selected table column; returns true when the command applies, or false when unavailable for the current editor state.

methods.name: deleteTableRow(): boolean
methods.description: Deletes the selected table row; returns true when the command applies, or false when unavailable for the current editor state.

methods.name: findNext(value?: string): boolean
methods.description: Finds and selects the next matching text, optionally replacing the current query with value. Returns whether a match was selected.

methods.name: findPrevious(value?: string): boolean
methods.description: Finds and selects the previous matching text, optionally replacing the current query with value. Returns whether a match was selected.

methods.name: focus(options?: FocusOptions): void
methods.description: Focuses the active editing surface, forwarding optional browser FocusOptions.

methods.name: getHTML(): string
methods.description: Returns the current HTML from the active source, rendered or rich-text mode; before initialization, returns the configured initial HTML.

methods.name: insertTable(rows = 3, columns = 3): boolean
methods.description: Replaces the current selection with a table of rows by columns and focuses it. Returns false if no editor or valid table can be created.

methods.name: setHTML(value: string): void
methods.description: Replaces the document from HTML, synchronizes active source/rendered views and reflects the supplied text in value.

methods.name: setSearchQuery(value: string, options: Omit<ConstructorParameters<typeof SearchQuery>[0], "search"> = {}): void
methods.description: Sets the search text and optional matching options on the rich-text editor; does nothing before initialization.

events.name: tp-prose-editor-change
events.description: Emitted immediately after tp-prose-editor-input for the same edit; it does not wait for blur. value contains the current HTML serialization.

events.name: tp-prose-editor-input
events.description: Emitted after an editing transaction or editor command updates the document. value contains the current HTML serialization.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-prose-editor>` element implements the <tp-icon name="prose-editor" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Prose-editor functionality: proseMirror-based rich text editor.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Edit the document directly and use the toolbar to format text, insert content, undo or redo changes. |
| :tp-icon:{name="file" size="1.25em"} Files | Creates, loads, saves, or exports the document. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-title" size="1.25em"} Types | Inserts paragraphs, headings, quotations, code, markup, math, and horizontal rules. |
| :tp-icon:{name="letter-f" size="1.25em"} Format | Applies inline text, math, and link formatting. |
| :tp-icon:{name="list-down" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="table" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="multimedia" size="1.25em"} Lists / Table / Media | Inserts and edits structured or media content. |
| :tp-icon:{name="emoticon-happy-outline" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="shapes" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="symbol" size="1.25em"} Emoji / Icon / Symbol | Opens a compact picker and inserts the selected item inline. |
| :tp-icon:{name="undo" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="redo" size="1.25em"} Undo / Redo | Navigates the editing history. |
| :tp-icon:{name="copy" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="cut" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="paste" size="1.25em"} :tp-icon:{name="select-all" size="1.25em"} Copy / Cut / Paste / Select all | Applies the corresponding clipboard or selection operation. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-clear" size="1.25em"} Clear formatting | Removes formatting from the selection. |
| :tp-icon:{name="language-html" size="1.25em"} HTML | Opens the HTML source and rendered views. |
| :tp-icon:{name="search" size="1.25em"} Search | Finds and highlights matching text. |
| :tp-icon:{name="dots-vertical" size="1.25em"} More | Shows or hides the secondary formatting toolbar. |
| :tp-icon:{name="keyboard-f1" size="1.25em"} Editor toolbar | Shows or hides the toolbar of the visible code or markup block editor. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| Focused controls | Use each control’s standard keyboard interaction.  |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
